records.subject: Getting started with Wrenfield
records.body:

Reply here if you need a hand.

Thanks,

draft.subject: Getting your first project set up
draft.body:
Hi Keiko,

Thanks again for flagging the Slack integration issue -- Tariq let you know that one's been taken care of, and your ticket is closed on our side.

If you're still finding a starting point, projects are the main organizing unit in Wrenfield, and tasks live inside them. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and when you're ready, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm glad to walk through your first project with you and answer anything else.

Best,
Chidi
